entry.summary:
Discover how art, science, nature, and Indigenous knowledge converge. On 20th February 2026, an expert panel explored the relationships between technology, mātauranga Māori, and the natural world, hosted by Miriama Kamo – inspired by the Breathe | Mauri Ora exhibition 2025–2026.

Featuring: Robin McNicholas from Marshmallow Laser Feast, Dr Dan Hikuroa, Dr Huhana Smith, Dr Rebecca Rice, and Dr Thom Linley, with Miriama Kamo.

E TUWHERA NEI | ON NOW – Breathe | Mauri Ora: An Immersive Journey into Nature by Marshmallow Laser Feast
